title: PBM Services Agreement Terms: Termination by the Sponsor, Rescission, Cancellation before Go-Live and Automatic Renewal
content:
## 1. Termination is the sponsor's decision

1.1 Termination is the plan sponsor's own decision: a termination notice is taken as a service request and becomes effective on the PBM Services Agreement only when the sponsor confirms it in writing.

1.2 A notice takes effect on the agreement only after a termination notice request has been taken from the sponsor.

1.3 When the notice takes effect, the agreement moves from active to termination pending, and the agreement records the date the notice was received and the termination date, which is the last day of the agreement.

## 2. Termination date and early termination fee

2.1 The termination date is no earlier than the arrangement's termination notice period, in calendar days, after the notice is received.

2.2 Terminating without cause before the end of the initial term costs the arrangement's early termination fee per enrolled employee for each remaining month of the initial term.

2.3 When the termination date is reached, the agreement ends and its status becomes terminated.

## 3. Rescission

The sponsor may rescind its notice before the termination date. A rescission the sponsor confirms returns the agreement from termination pending to active, and the recorded notice date and termination date are cleared.

## 4. Automatic renewal

Otherwise the agreement renews automatically for the arrangement's renewal term, in months, at each renewal date; the renewal date then moves to the end of the new term.

## 5. Cancellation before go-live

A sponsor may cancel before go-live, which ends the agreement without an early termination fee. A cancellation the sponsor confirms moves the agreement from pending implementation straight to terminated.

## Status of the agreement at each event

| Event | Status before | Status after | Who brings it about |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sponsor confirms a written termination notice | Active | Termination pending | The sponsor's confirmation |
| Sponsor confirms rescinding the notice before the termination date | Termination pending | Active | The sponsor's confirmation |
| Termination date reached | Termination pending | Terminated | Reaching the date |
| Sponsor confirms cancelling before go-live | Pending implementation | Terminated | The sponsor's confirmation |
| Renewal date reached with no termination | Active | Active, renewed for another term | Automatic |

## Worked points (hypothetical inputs)

- *Earliest termination date.* Notice received on day 0 under a hypothetical notice period of 90 calendar days: a termination date on day 90 or later meets the notice requirement; a termination date on day 89 does not.
- *Early termination fee.* A hypothetical fee of 1.50 per enrolled employee per month, 600 enrolled employees, and a termination without cause leaving 8 months of the initial term: 1.50 multiplied by 600 multiplied by 8 gives 7200.00 USD.
- *After the initial term.* A termination without cause whose termination date falls after the initial term has ended is not before the end of the initial term, so the early termination fee clause does not reach it.
- *Before go-live.* A cancellation before go-live carries no early termination fee.
- *Rescission timing.* A rescission is available up to, but not on or after, the termination date.
